pricing.heroSub: One flat subscription per role, billed in VND — no commission on bookings, ever.

model.description: Get booked for shoots and build your portfolio.

studio.description: Rent out your studio space by the hour or day.

multipleRoles.a: Right now each account holds one provider role at a time (e.g. Photographer or Studio, not both). You can switch to a different role anytime in Settings.

afterTrial.q: What happens after the free trial?
afterTrial.a: After 14 days your card is charged automatically at the rate you selected. You can cancel anytime before the trial ends and you won't be charged.

cancelAnytime.a: Yes. Cancelling keeps your plan active until the end of the current billing period, and all your data is kept if you want to reactivate later.

commission.q: Do you take a commission on bookings?
commission.a: No — Fgrapher charges a flat subscription per role, not a percentage of your bookings.

paymentMethods.q: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.a: Credit and debit cards, processed securely through Stripe, plus local Vietnamese payment methods if you enable them in your Stripe settings.

annualDiscount.q: Is there a discount for annual billing?
annualDiscount.a: Yes — switch to yearly billing on this page and pay 20% less than the monthly rate, charged once a year.

about.metaDescription: Fgrapher is the platform connecting clients with identity-verified photographers, videographers, make-up artists, and studios nationwide.
about.title: About Fgrapher
about.subtitle: The platform connecting photographers, videographers, make-up artists, and studios with clients looking for them.
about.body1: Fgrapher connects clients with the visual creators behind the shoots they love — and connects those creators with clients looking for their services. Build a portfolio, list your services, manage bookings, and get found, all in one place.
about.body2: Fgrapher is currently in early access. If something isn't working the way you'd expect, let us know — see the Contact page.

help.subtitle: Answers to common questions.

becomeProvider.q: How do I become a provider?
becomeProvider.a: Register and choose the role that fits you — Photographer, Videographer, Make-up Artist, or Studio. Each account currently holds one provider role at a time; you can switch to a different one in Settings.

howBookingWorks.a: Clients pick a service and an open time slot on a provider's profile, then send a booking request. Providers can accept or decline requests right from their dashboard.

isFree.a: Browsing and booking are completely free for clients. Provider roles are currently assigned a plan manually by the Fgrapher team — self-service subscriptions via online payment aren't open yet.

howToContactSupport.a: Use the Contact page — the Fgrapher team will respond as soon as possible.

guidelines.metaDescription: Content standards for every profile and photo uploaded to Fgrapher — age requirements, image rights, moderation, and how violations are handled.
guidelines.title: Community guidelines
guidelines.subtitle: Apply to every profile and every photo uploaded to Fgrapher
guidelines.intro: Fgrapher stores real photos of real people. The standards below exist to keep the platform safe and professional for everyone — photographers, models, and clients alike. Every account must comply; violations can lead to content removal, temporary suspension, or a permanent ban.

prohibited.heading: Content that isn't allowed
items: Photos of anyone under 18, in any context.

Photos you don't have the right to use — under Article 32 of the 2015 Civil Code, using someone's likeness requires their consent. You must be the subject, the photographer, or have the subject's clear consent before uploading.

ageRequirement.heading: Age requirement
ageRequirement.body: Every Fgrapher account — not just Model — must be 18 or older. This is required at registration, not optional.

moderation.heading: Photos are moderated before going public
moderation.body: Every portfolio photo stays "Pending review" until the Fgrapher team checks and approves it. Unapproved photos are only visible to you, never on a public profile or in search results. You can still build and edit your portfolio as a draft while you wait.

violations.heading: Violation process — a 3-strike suspension
violations.body: Each time a photo is rejected for violating content standards (whether caught by automated scanning or by the moderation team), your account gets one violation point. At the third point, the account is automatically suspended. Serious violations (e.g. suspected involvement of someone under 18) can result in an immediate suspension and a report to authorities where the law requires it.

appeals.heading: Appealing a rejected photo
appeals.body: If you believe a photo was rejected in error, message support through the Contact page with which photo and why you think the decision was wrong. Every appeal is reviewed independently by a different admin.

reporting.heading: Reporting a violation
reporting.body: Every profile has a "Report" option. Reports about inappropriate content or a profile suspected of belonging to someone under 18 go into a high-priority queue and are handled as soon as possible.

modelSafetyNotice.title: Before you book
modelSafetyNotice.body: Meet in public or at a registered studio for a first shoot, and let someone know where you'll be. Fgrapher never asks for payment outside the platform — report anything that feels off.
